name: von Hippel-Lindau tumor suppressor

function.text: VHL encodes the substrate-recognition component of an ubiquitin-ligase complex that promotes degradation of hypoxia-inducible factors under oxygen-replete conditions.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to von Hippel-Lindau disease (autosomal dominant); Chuvash polycythemia (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Paraganglioma; Pheochromocytoma; Endolymphatic sac tumor. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: VHL encodes the substrate-recognition component of an ubiquitin-ligase complex that promotes degradation of hypoxia-inducible factors under oxygen-replete conditions.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with von Hippel-Lindau disease (autosomal dominant); Chuvash polycythemia (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving VHL have been reported in clear cell renal cell carcinoma, renal clear cell carcinoma, and pheochromocytoma.
